topic: one customer start to finish: the chain of texts that send themselves
hook: You don't need an office manager. You need texts that send themselves.
caption:
Texts that send themselves for contractors: comment AUTO and I'll reply with how it works.

Picture a roofer in Tulsa named Dave. Tuesday at 2 PM he's on a steep roof when a caller rings, and he can't pick up. Wednesday he's running 20 minutes late. Thursday the job wraps and nobody asks Mrs. Lopez for a review.

Three texts fix all of it. Missed call text back. On my way. A thank you with one link to his Google reviews.

Dave typed none of them. Works for roofers, HVAC techs, plumbers in Dallas or Denver.

#contractor #smallbusinesstips #automation #n8n #roofing
